switchSequence: Modeled status path begins open, closes at 5 ms, opens again at 10 ms.
interpretation: The simulated input is fail-high for the modeled open loop and near ground for the modeled closed contact. This is an idealized logic-status example, not a safety circuit validation.
limitations: No controller input threshold, noise, wire capacitance, isolation, relay/safety hardware or board has been qualified.
The status channel is not a safety function and does not interrupt motor power.
Simulation is not a physical wiring or stop test.
